info.title: Galaxy Unit API
info.description: REST for AI agents and scripts. A key acts as the member who made it (never above admin) under row-level security. Money is a decimal string. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone (see /me). Errors carry code, field and a hint the agent can act on. Read /for-agents first: https://galaxyunit.app/for-agents

schema.description: Change an EXISTING client/contact: phone, email, location (marina), object (boat) name / size / model / year, slip, notes, billing address, company or name. Use for "поменяй телефон Janet", "Sarah moved to Bluffers Park", "update Mike's boat length to 40". Only pass the fields being changed — everything omitted is left exactly as it is. NEVER create a second contact to "fix" one; to add a NEW client use create_contact. For jobs use update_job. Only the fields being changed; the id comes from the path.

schema.description: Create a job/booking for a client. Can set price, deposit, services and assigned workers with hours. Use for "book a job", "schedule…", "create a job for X at $Y with worker Z for N hours". BOOK FIRST: a job needs only a client, a title and a date — do NOT ask for size, price or deposit before creating it, and do not withhold the booking because pricing is unknown. Always pass the requested service as a services line; give a price ONLY when the owner said one — otherwise OMIT price and the server takes it from the price list (per-foot services are multiplied by the client's boat length on the server). Never invent a price. REST callers may pass contact_id (uuid) instead of client_name.

total_price.description: Whole-job price in CAD — ONLY for a job that has no service lines ("поставь цену 1200"). If the job is itemized, change a line instead (set_service_price / add_services); the server refuses a bare total on an itemized job.

name.description: Service name as the user said it

unit_price.description: Unit price in CAD — only if the user said a price; omit to take it from the price list

remove_services.description: Names of lines to REMOVE from the job

schema.description: Change an EXISTING job: its stage, dates, title, location, price, deposit or notes, or its service lines (add / reprice / remove a line; the total is recomputed on the server). Use for "move X to scheduled", "перенеси на пятницу", "поменяй этап", "raise the price on Y". Only pass the fields being changed — everything omitted is left exactly as it is. To create a NEW job use create_job; for worker hours use log_job_hours. Only the fields being changed; the id comes from the path.

schema.description: Create a QUOTE (estimate) for a client as a draft document. Use for "send a quote", "quote Kai for…", "сделай квоту / смету". Either name the JOB to quote (its service lines are copied) or give the client and the line items with prices. Never invent a price: take it from what the user said or from get_price_list, otherwise ask. Tax comes from the business settings; the card shows lines and total before anything is created. REST callers may pass contact_id (uuid) instead of client_name.

schema.description: Create an INVOICE as a draft document. Use for "invoice X", "bill Nuno for yesterday's job", "выставь счёт". Either name the JOB (its service lines are copied) or give the client and the line items with prices. Never invent a price — ask. Tax comes from the business settings and the due date from its payment terms; the card shows lines, tax and total before anything is created. To record money already received use add_payment, not this. REST callers may pass contact_id (uuid) instead of client_name.
